newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby soybeans up, grains steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby soybeans up, grains steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf spot soybean values were higher on Wednesday in reaction to limit losses at the Chicago Board of Trade, while grain values were unchanged in quiet conditions, exporters said.
CBOT soybeans tumbled the 30 cent per bushel limit on Wednesday, hit by news that Cargill was importing South American soybeans to alleviate tightness in southeast processing plants.
Grain FOB values were steady, but exporters expected further declines in wheat as harvest progressed. Cash sources said combines were rolling in northern Texas.
"There's nothing going on in the FOB wheat market," one exporter said. "We're just on the brink of harvest. I suspect tomorrow we'll get into pretty good gear in Louisiana and southern Arkansas."
